message: All 5 rows of proof-obligations.planned.jsonl were missing the required `schema_version` field. The canonical proof-obligation/v1 schema mandates schema_version as the FIRST required field; its absence prevented any downstream validator from confirming the row schema. Verified by jq on the prior pass: every row yielded schema_version == MISSING.
required_fix: Add `"schema_version": "proof-obligation/v1"` as a top-level field to all 5 rows (PO-09aaz-001..PO-09aaz-005) of proof-obligations.planned.jsonl.
evidence_refs: jq: all 5 rows now have schema_version=proof-obligation/v1

message: All 5 rows were missing the canonical `target` field (per proof-obligation/v1 schema). Legacy aliases `layer` and `checker` are explicitly invalid per proof-schemas.md. The planner had substituted `artifact` for `target`, but `artifact` is a SEPARATE required field naming the produced artifact path, not the target verifier target.
required_fix: Add `"target": "<canonical-target>"` to all 5 rows. PO-09aaz-001 -> verification/verus/vb-vzcuf-PS-008.rs (spec mirror); PO-09aaz-002..005 -> crates/vb_storage/src/batch/append_event.rs (production site).
evidence_refs: jq: all 5 rows now have non-null `target` (verus spec or production path)

message: All 5 rows were missing the required `workdir` field. The proof-obligation/v1 schema requires workdir to be present so the formal-verifier (State 12) knows where to invoke the command.

All 5 rows were missing the required `model_bounds` field. The trusted-base-plan.md (sections 1-2) lists the bounded state (MAX_BATCH_COUNT=10000, INDEX_ACTION_KEY_BYTES=13, JOURNAL_KEY_BYTES=17, byte_limit=1048576) but those bounds were not propagated to the obligation rows.
required_fix: Add `"model_bounds": [...]` to each row referencing the trusted-base-plan.md sections.
evidence_refs: jq: all 5 rows now have non-empty model_bounds arrays citing MAX_BATCH_COUNT, INDEX_ACTION_KEY_BYTES, JOURNAL_KEY_BYTES, byte_limit, and (for PO-09aaz-003) arbitrary triple ranges

message: All 5 rows were missing the required `tool_metadata` field. The plan emitted commands but did not pin versions or flags. tool_metadata captures verifier-version pins and command flags (verus: 0.2026.05.05.d03e906 + --crate-type=lib + --edition 2021; cargo: nightly-2026-04-28 + --test).
evidence_refs: jq: all 5 rows now have tool_metadata (verifier_version + flags)

message: All 5 rows were missing the required `trusted_base_refs` field. The trusted-base-plan.md enumerates 7 sections, but the obligation rows did not cite which trusted-base sections they invoke.
evidence_refs: jq: all 5 rows now have trusted_base_refs as numeric arrays referencing trusted-base-plan.md sections 1..7

message: All 5 rows were missing the required `risk_tags` field. The planner had used a `risk` field with comma-separated strings instead. The canonical schema requires structured arrays.
required_fix: Add `"risk_tags": [...]` to each row as a structured array.
evidence_refs: jq: all 5 rows now have risk_tags as structured arrays

message: All 5 rows used the alias field `claim` instead of the canonical `domain_claim`. Per proof-schemas.md, `domain_claim` is the required canonical field for the domain-level claim of the obligation.
required_fix: Rename the field `claim` to `domain_claim` in all 5 rows of proof-obligations.planned.jsonl.
evidence_refs: jq: all 5 rows now have domain_claim (no legacy `claim` field)

message: All 5 rows used `proof_seed_ids` (array) instead of the canonical singular `proof_seed_id`. The proof-obligation/v1 schema requires `proof_seed_id` (singular string) per row.
required_fix: Rename `proof_seed_ids` to `proof_seed_id` and pick a single canonical primary seed per obligation. Document secondary seeds in `assumptions`.
evidence_refs: jq: all 5 rows now have proof_seed_id as a singular string (no legacy `proof_seed_ids` array)
Each row's `assumptions` documents secondary proof seeds as needed (e.g., PO-09aaz-001 documents PS-003 and PS-008 as secondary)
